items: CodeGama is hiring: Operations, Digital Marketing, Support
scenes.say: Job alert! CodeGama in Bengaluru is hiring for three roles. Operations Executive, Digital Marketing Executive and Support Executive.

items: Salary: up to ₹2 LPA, based on skills
scenes.say: One. Operations Executive, for freshers with a degree in any stream. Salary up to two lakh rupees a year. You need good communication and basic M S Excel, and rotational shifts. This role is for male candidates only.
Two. Digital Marketing Executive. You need two years of experience, and salary is based on performance.

items: Apply with the same email and referral ID
scenes.say: Three. Support Executive, also at CodeGama in Bengaluru.

items: Mention the role + referral ID: CODEGAMA-OPS26
Never pay money to anyone for a job
scenes.say: To apply, email your resume to marketing at codegama dot com. Mention the role and the referral I D, CODEGAMA O P S 26. Never pay money to anyone for a job.
Full details are in the description. More free job updates on Marg Disha dot com.
